    //==
    // # IClosedCurve3D
    //
    // A 3D curve satisfying Eval(0) = Eval(1).

    // The distance between the first and last evaluated points; zero for an
    // exactly closed curve.
    ClosureGap(self: IClosedCurve3D): Number
        => self.ChordLength;

    // True when the endpoints coincide within the given (non-negative) tolerance.
    IsProperlyClosed(self: IClosedCurve3D, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => self.ClosureGap <= tolerance;

    //==
    // # The angular-curve bridges
    //
    // Bodies for the angular curve interfaces declared in `curves.concepts.plato`:
    // the canonical-parameter evaluation of an angular curve is derivable once for
    // every implementor, so each angular curve costs only its Eval(Angle). Curves
    // whose sweep is not a single full turn override Eval(Number) directly,
    // exactly as the `Angles`-carrying spirals do over the generic polar mapping
    // in `curves-shapes.library.plato`.

    // The position at the canonical parameter t: the angular evaluation taken
    // at t full turns.
    Eval(curve: IAngularCurve2D, t: Number): Point2D
        => curve.Eval(t.Turns);

    // The position at the canonical parameter t: the angular evaluation taken
    // at t full turns.
    Eval(curve: IAngularCurve3D, t: Number): Point3D
        => curve.Eval(t.Turns);

    //==
    // # Derived functions for the curve capability interfaces
    //
    // Bodies for the interfaces that a curve may additionally satisfy, declared in
    // `curves.concepts.plato`: periodicity, first
    // derivatives in the plane and in space, a moving frame, planarity, polar form,
    // and arc-length parameterization.
    //
    // TODO(interface-gap): a true tangent or curvature by analytic differentiation is
    // still not derivable — it needs the parameter derivative of the evaluation, which
    // none of these interfaces expose (trigonometry and the square root are now available
    // via Angle.Cos/Sin and Number.Sqrt, so the polar-to-Cartesian conversion below is
    // derived directly). Analytic differential helpers are left to the concrete types.

    //==
    // # IPeriodicCurve
    //
    // A curve whose parameterization repeats with an explicit Period (Number).
    // IPeriodicCurve<TRange> inherits ICurve<TRange> as well as IPeriodic<Number>,
    // so both parameter arithmetic on the period AND wrapped evaluation are
    // derivable. TRange is the evaluated value type.

    // Folds a parameter into the half-open interval [0, Period). The extra
    // "+ Period then modulo" corrects the truncated remainder, which is negative
    // for negative t. Precondition: Period > 0.
    WrapParameter(self: IPeriodicCurve<$TRange>, t: Number): Number
        => ((t % self.Period) + self.Period) % self.Period;

    // The value at parameter t evaluated on the primary period: Eval(t mod Period).
    // Any t (negative or beyond one period) maps to the equivalent value in
    // [0, Period). Precondition: Period > 0.
    EvalWrapped(self: IPeriodicCurve<$TRange>, t: Number): $TRange
        => self.Eval(self.WrapParameter(t));

    // The fraction of one period that t represents, in [0, 1). Precondition:
    // Period > 0.
    NormalizedPhase(self: IPeriodicCurve<$TRange>, t: Number): Number
        => self.WrapParameter(t) / self.Period;

    // Half of one period.
    HalfPeriod(self: IPeriodicCurve<$TRange>): Number
        => self.Period.Half;

    // Floor(t / Period): the index of the period containing t (-1 for t just
    // below zero, not truncation). Precondition: Period > 0.
    PeriodCount(self: IPeriodicCurve<$TRange>, t: Number): Integer
        => (t / self.Period).Floor.ToInteger;

    // The number of repetitions per unit parameter (the reciprocal of the
    // period). Precondition: Period > 0.
    Frequency(self: IPeriodicCurve<$TRange>): Number
        => self.Period.Inverse;

    //==
    // # IDifferentiableCurve2D
    //
    // A 2D curve with a first derivative: TangentAt is the (unnormalized)
    // velocity, CurvatureAt is the signed plane curvature (positive turning
    // left). Unit tangents, plane normals, and the radius of curvature follow.

    // The unit-length tangent at t. Precondition: the tangent is non-zero.
    UnitTangentAt(self: IDifferentiableCurve2D, t: Number): Vector2D
        => self.TangentAt(t).Normalize;

    // The instantaneous speed (tangent magnitude) at t.
    SpeedAt(self: IDifferentiableCurve2D, t: Number): Number
        => self.TangentAt(t).Magnitude;

    // The left-hand normal at t: the tangent rotated a quarter turn
    // counter-clockwise, (-y, x). Not normalized.
    LeftNormalAt(self: IDifferentiableCurve2D, t: Number): Vector2D
        => (-self.TangentAt(t).Y, self.TangentAt(t).X);

    // The unit left-hand normal at t. Precondition: the tangent is non-zero.
    UnitNormalAt(self: IDifferentiableCurve2D, t: Number): Vector2D
        => self.LeftNormalAt(t).Normalize;

    // The curvature vector at t: the signed plane curvature scaled by the unit
    // left normal, pointing toward the centre of curvature. Precondition: the
    // tangent is non-zero.
    CurvatureVectorAt(self: IDifferentiableCurve2D, t: Number): Vector2D
        => self.UnitNormalAt(t) * self.CurvatureAt(t);

    // The radius of curvature at t: the reciprocal of the unsigned curvature.
    // Precondition: the curvature is non-zero (a straight point has infinite
    // radius). See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Radius_of_curvature.
    RadiusOfCurvatureAt(self: IDifferentiableCurve2D, t: Number): Number
        => 1.0 / self.CurvatureAt(t).Abs;

    // True when the curve turns to the left at t (positive signed curvature).
    TurnsLeftAt(self: IDifferentiableCurve2D, t: Number): Boolean
        => self.CurvatureAt(t) > 0.0;

    // True when the curve is (near) straight at t: unsigned curvature within the
    // given non-negative tolerance of zero.
    IsStraightAt(self: IDifferentiableCurve2D, t: Number, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => self.CurvatureAt(t).Abs <= tolerance;

    //==
    // # IDifferentiableCurve3D
    //
    // A 3D curve with a first derivative: TangentAt (velocity), CurvatureAt
    // (unsigned space curvature), TorsionAt (departure from the osculating
    // plane).

    // The unit-length tangent at t. Precondition: the tangent is non-zero.
    UnitTangentAt(self: IDifferentiableCurve3D, t: Number): Vector3D
        => self.TangentAt(t).Normalize;

    // The instantaneous speed (tangent magnitude) at t.
    SpeedAt(self: IDifferentiableCurve3D, t: Number): Number
        => self.TangentAt(t).Magnitude;

    // The radius of curvature at t: the reciprocal of the (unsigned space)
    // curvature. Precondition: the curvature is non-zero.
    RadiusOfCurvatureAt(self: IDifferentiableCurve3D, t: Number): Number
        => 1.0 / self.CurvatureAt(t);

    // True when the curve is (near) straight at t: the unsigned space curvature
    // is within the given non-negative tolerance of zero.
    IsStraightAt(self: IDifferentiableCurve3D, t: Number, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => self.CurvatureAt(t) <= tolerance;
